spanish: y los dos los riñones y la grasa que sobre ellos, que sobre los lomos, y el lóbulo sobre el hígado, sobre los riñones la quitará.

findings.issue: The 3fs suffix resumes the feminine singular lobe (the DOM object); the fat is masculine. Spanish la agrees only with grasa and cannot resume masculine lóbulo, so the removed object shifts to the fat.
Doubled determiner los dos los is grammatical smoothing of the dual construct plus the definite plural and does not add a referent.

notes: The two relatives, the על phrases, and hiphil 3ms remove are otherwise represented.
